# Frozen PDF text precision regression input

This is the unchanged nine-page raw PDF generated by the project-owned PdfFixture and Astra read-only actual r4 package probe on 2026-10-09. It reproduces translation, noncollapsed advance, affine, accumulated advance and font-size conversion loss, with ordinary English, shear, CJK and spacing controls. Production code does not consume this file.

The gzip container is only lossless storage (level9, mtime0); 11,532,803 bytes, SHA-256 `024e4dbd0f735b90c9cf50f91d1e245cfab1caca9e2e73af243afa8fb4def3fa`. Decompressed bytes: 21,698,835. SHA-256: `d78e78154690b11a2e6c8db61d5ef458aef583e2706aa0da8ae065b3460898eb`. The actual embedded full static Noto Sans CJK SC Regular font remains byte-for-byte SHA-256 `3012a9b63f5eca3e3b38f23a1be5ed504675e394abf8e7a4fa981506582c04aa`; its SIL Open Font License is adjacent. Generated PDF content is project MIT. No font normalization or subsetting was applied.

The original generator, raw source, broken r4 outputs, input/font/package hashes, and design are retained in `docs/evidence/pdf-vectors/review-r6.tar.zst` under `text-precision-r5-design/`. Linux CI rejected regeneration that did not match the original frozen PDF. Consume these exact original bytes on every platform; do not regenerate a different file and weaken the SHA assertion. Checks still bind source size/hash, original embedded font identity, page policy, complete native Unicode and actual package output.
